card.name: Study codes and numbers in oncology trials
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits, hyphens or linking words inside or just before trial names and numbers in cancer drug labels, such as EORTC 26101, AAML0531 or TAX324.

modes.label: Inside trial codes
modes.description: The gap or digit within a study name before its number is finished.

modes.label: Before dose numbers
modes.description: A space before a dose or day count in chemotherapy regimens.

modes.label: Joining study names
modes.description: A linking word or bracket between trial names or descriptors.
modes.example: BEIZRAY containing arms of the TAX323<< and>> TAX324 studies

card.writes: It pushes toward tumor-related words (tumor, tumors) and away from unrelated word starts.
card.plain: It fires inside the names and numbers of cancer trials and chemotherapy schedules, just before the next digit.
